messages:
sarah: FYI ACME sent over a security questionnaire this morning. Top asks: RBAC scoping for org vs project, audit log retention & where logs are stored, BYOK/KMS integration details, vuln triage SLA, and incident response evidence (runbooks + SOC2 artifacts). Can we consolidate answers by EOD? https://acme.example/csq.pdf

elinor: Thanks — I skimmed it. Short notes: RBAC = our Console roles + API tokens; we support org-wide admins, project-level viewers/editors, and service roles. Need to include how we restrict key creation to ops.

matt: Adding specifics:
- RBAC roles: admin, infra-admin, developer, viewer, service-account. admin and infra-admin require 2FA + SSO group.
- Audit logs: retained 365 days by default in encrypted S3 buckets in customer region; we can extend retention on Dedicated/Private. Events include auth attempts, token creates, model-publish, deployment changes, config changes, KMS operations.
- Example audit entry format: ```{ "time":"2026-03-18T15:02:03Z", "actor":"service-account:ingest-worker", "action":"deployment.update", "object":"deployment/rdw-prod-1", "result":"success" }```

j onah: For KMS/BYOK: Private and Dedicated customers can bring keys via AWS KMS CMKs or external HSMs. We use envelope encryption: data keys generated per-tenant, wrapped with customer CMK. We can provide a key policy sample if they want HSM-specific clauses. Note: we don't persist plaintext data keys.

sec-bot: Ticket created: SEC-2026-324 (csq-acme). Assigned to elinor, matt. Due: 2026-03-19 18:00 UTC.

elinor: On vuln triage SLA: we commit to triage critical sev1 within 24 hours, high within 48 hours, and we share CVE/mitigation timeline with enterprise customers. We should mention our internal runbook for patch/testing and rollback.

matt: For KMS answer add this snippet to the questionnaire reply: ```We support customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS), and PKCS#11-compatible HSMs for Private deployments. Our runtime performs envelope encryption; customer master keys never leave your KMS.```

sarah: Do we have SOC2 evidence we can attach? Auditor report + control narrative? Customer asked for control IDs around change management and incident response.

elinor: Yes — attachable: SOC2 Type II report (redacted), incident response playbook (link internal), change control policy doc. I can prepare a redacted bundle.

jonah: I'll draft the short one-page FAQ for CSMs: Qs + bullets for RBAC, logs, KMS, vuln triage, IR. Will put in PR to docs and ping here.

matt: I'll draft the technical language for RBAC & KMS and add the audit event examples. Posting to the thread in ~2 hours.

sarah: Awesome — can we get a single consolidated PDF for ACME with redacted SOC2 + answers + runbook excerpts? If yes, I'll send it.

elinor: Yes, I'll assemble the bundle after matt/jonah post their sections. Action items below.

Action items:
- matt: draft RBAC + audit log + KMS text and example entries (due in 2h)
- jonah: one-page CSM FAQ (PR to docs, due EOD)
- elinor: prepare redacted SOC2 + IR playbook bundle and finalize answers (due EOD)
- sarah: send consolidated PDF to ACME once bundle is ready
- sec-bot: link ticket SEC-2026-324 to customer account and log deliverables

sarah: Thanks team. Please use thread for any clarifying Qs. :thumbsup:
